pr_title: Bluetooth: l2cap: make TX path service all connections
pr_body:
Similar to ISO connections, ACL connections are not serviced as fast as
possible. Change this, and try to send as much as we have resources for.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/74427
pr_comments: @jori-nordic since we're in the 3.7 release stabilization phase, I believe you'd need to have a corresponding bug report if this is to get merged before the release.

> should_stop_tx

I prefer re-triggering the same code-path instead of having two different code-paths for pulling data / finding out we have data.

> > should_stop_tx
> 
> I prefer re-triggering the same code-path instead of having two different code-paths for pulling data / finding out we have data.

Ok, how about an unconditional `bt_tx_irq_raise` in `bt_conn_tx_processor` just before calling `tx_data_pull`?

> We can't do this from conn.c as we don't know if the NULL returned is because the current channel is out of data or because it has data but it can't send it (e.g. the current buf is being "viewed" already).

From the corresponding ISO PR. TLDR we get an infinite loop if you can't send the data for some other reason. Try it.
edit: I tried this first, but didn't work. That's why I trigger the IRQ from the upper layer in those two PRs.
Ok. Free to merge this. I trust you understand it better than I do right now. :+1:

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Host: TX path doesn't process all ready ACL connections
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The host doesn't send as much data as it has resources for.

**To Reproduce**
Run this test: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/74401/commits/7950b44050a1e5151739a7492df3d21edf6f0844

-> See that not all the L2CAP channels (that are on separate ACLs) are not pulled from immediately as they should.

**Expected behavior**
The Host should send as much data as it can to the controller if it has resources to do so.

**Impact**
Annoyance. Higher data latency.

**Logs and console output**
![image](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/68428270/cccf239c-cfe4-46c6-b6dd-8bca644333e2)

**Additional context**
Discovered while fixing https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/74321 .
This regression is due to https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/72090 which rewrites the TX data path.
